{
  "dataset_name": "bng_breast_w",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "cell_uniformity_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of cell size and shape uniformity, providing a smooth composite feature for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [0.9, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a stable, linearly separable dimension by combining highly correlated uniformity metrics.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Cell_Size_Uniformity + Cell_Shape_Uniformity) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "size_shape_discrepancy",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute difference between cell size and shape uniformity.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear interactions between size and shape uniformity that a linear SVM might otherwise miss.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(Cell_Size_Uniformity - Cell_Shape_Uniformity)"
    },
    {
      "name": "overall_abnormality_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Unweighted average of all nine cytological characteristics.",
      "value_range": [0.5, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a strong, continuous severity measure that acts as a primary axis for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Clump_Thickness + Cell_Size_Uniformity + Cell_Shape_Uniformity + Marginal_Adhesion + Single_Epi_Cell_Size + Bare_Nuclei + Bland_Chromatin + Normal_Nucleoli + Mitoses) / 9.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "nuclear_severity_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of nuclear-specific features: Bare Nuclei, Normal Nucleoli, and Bland Chromatin.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates nuclear abnormalities into a single continuous feature, improving margin clarity for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(Bare_Nuclei + Normal_Nucleoli + Bland_Chromatin) / 3.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "mitosis_to_thickness_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of mitoses to clump thickness, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights cases with disproportionately high mitotic activity relative to clump thickness.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Mitoses / (Clump_Thickness + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "adhesion_to_size_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of marginal adhesion to cell size uniformity, smoothed by adding 1 to the denominator.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Exposes the relationship between cell adhesion loss and size irregularity as a continuous feature.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "Marginal_Adhesion / (Cell_Size_Uniformity + 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "max_cell_irregularity",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The maximum value between cell size uniformity and cell shape uniformity.",
      "value_range": [0.8, 13.0],
      "feature_family": "extreme_value",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ensures that the most severe uniformity metric drives the linear decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(Cell_Size_Uniformity, Cell_Shape_Uniformity)"
    },
    {
      "name": "log_bare_nuclei",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed bare nuclei score to reduce the impact of extreme values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.7],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes the distribution of bare nuclei, making it more suitable for linear SVM weights.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "clump_thickness_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of clump thickness from its training set mean.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures abnormal clump thickness in either direction as a positive magnitude.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(Clump_Thickness - 4.364)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_severity_feature_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of key features (Clump Thickness, Cell Size Uniformity, Bare Nuclei) exceeding typical normal thresholds.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "count",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a robust, step-wise severity indicator that complements continuous features.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(Clump_Thickness > 5.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(Cell_Size_Uniformity > 4.0, 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(Bare_Nuclei > 4.0, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_cellular_abnormality_risk",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses the overall risk of severe cellular abnormality based on the combination of cell characteristics, providing a continuous risk score.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures complex, non-linear expert judgments about cell morphology that simple formulas might miss.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "semantic_proliferation_potential",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assesses the potential for rapid cell division and tissue invasion based on Mitoses, Single Epithelial Cell Size, and Clump Thickness.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic evaluation of growth potential, offering a distinct semantic axis for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
